test_channel_close_immediately_after_cal: test that closing a gRPC channel immediately after invoking a stream-stream call returns CANCELLED status
test_channel_close_while_call_active: test that closing a gRPC channel while a streaming call is active cancels the response iterator
test_context_manager_channel_close: test that exiting a gRPC channel context manager cancels all active streaming calls on that channel
test_concurrent_channel_closes: test that multiple concurrent threads calling channel close do not cause deadlocks or crashes
test_callback_exception_no_deadlock: test that raising an exception in a future done callback does not cause a deadlock on the channel
